_about: Round 6's karma gate spec for qa/gate.py (film-qa gate --spec). Built on r5/gate_spec.json. complaints: no waiver on these areas. Round 6 adds garment.open_edge_shrunk (the operator, 07 Nov: 'his neck looks very weird, also it looks like it has a cut') and lips.eye_onsets (the orchestrator's signed per-line strip check); lips.render_lag_frames becomes INFO by the orchestrator's ruling (an invalid measure, a scope change, not a waiver). Numbers: r6/numbers/*.json in the gate contract, merged by r6/merge_numbers.py.

shot.start_motion_ratio.what: head-box motion in a presenter shot's first 4 frame pairs over the median of the next 12 (r5/gate_numbers.py settle on the rendered frames): a head snapping into its pose or a hair sim settling at the cut
shot.start_motion_ratio.where: S15 f1080-1084 (her head tilts in ~10 deg)
r4: round 4's S15 final_d, the same shape as round 5 (12.33): her head tilt-in is pre-existing
shot.start_motion_ratio.why: orchestrator, 06 Nov round 5b: her S15 start tilt is pre-existing (round 4 the same), NOT a blocker tonight, but REPORTED in the gate, not hidden; INFO until calibrated (shot starts move by design: S16 reads 2.8)

garment.open_edge_shrunk.what: face-mesh vertices on its OPEN lower edge (the stitch to the body at the neck base) that the neck backstop shrinks: a shrunk open edge pulls the face off the body and reads as a torn lip / dark crevice above the collar
garment.open_edge_shrunk.where: his face mesh as built for the finals (S13, S15 sharp frames show it)
garment.open_edge_shrunk.how: r5/neck_backstop.py mask report shrunk_on_open_edge (agent-02 b07e8fd1) on the mask the finals' build used; 0 by construction when no backstop shrink is applied (say so in the number's where)
must_fail: round 5b loop 2 (the delivered candidate): 92/92 open-edge verts shrunk; the orchestrator saw a ragged lip + crevice at f1085/1100/1128 and the operator 'a cut'
garment.open_edge_shrunk.why: neck_px cannot see a torn skin edge ABOVE the collar (gate v2, round 5b); this is the geometric cause, measured

r4: INFO in round 6 by the orchestrator's ruling (cc-64d05f6e, 07 Nov): an invalid measure. Round 5b evidence: the round-4 control fails too (L1 +6.64, L2 +16.95, L4a +12.38), the sign is random, it is not repeatable (round 4 L1 -1.36 -> +6.64 on new boxes). A scope change, not a waiver; the curve items stay hard. agent-01's landmark measure replaces it as a hard line once validated (null control, round 4 L1, a +6 f shifted mux)

lips.eye_onsets.what: the orchestrator's by-eye check of mouth onset vs audio onset on EVERY line of the rendered cut: 1 only if every line reads a 0-2 frame lead (mouth opens 0-2 f before the sound) or is occluded with the occlusion named
lips.eye_onsets.where: every VO line of the 65 s cut (L1, L2, L3a, L3b, L4a, L4b)
lips.eye_onsets.how: strip file signed by cc-64d05f6e: r6/numbers/eye_onsets.json {"lines": {line: {"lead_f": n | null, "verdict": "pass"|"fail"|"occluded", "note"}}, "by": "cc-64d05f6e"} -> r6/merge_numbers.py
r4: round 4: lips moved before the audio on L1 (the operator)
lips.eye_onsets.why: the render measure is invalid; the eye is the judge the operator is, line by line, written down

r4: round 5b read 8.93 at S15 f1082 (her pre-existing start tilt-in, place() cross-fade on screen): round 6 renders S15 WITH agent-04's place fix (b475dfe5, b22f3372); no exclusion window

shot.settle_step_deg.what: worst frame-to-frame head turn beyond perfkit's plan at a section's start or the film's end (perf.py settle, AFTER samples)
shot.settle_step_deg.where: each presenter section start and the film's last frame f1559
r4: round 5b read 13.65 on the rendered S15 start (start_motion_ratio); before e4c9c01f f1559 read him 1.999 / her 4.201
shot.settle_step_deg.why: agent-04 K2: INFO until calibrated; shot.start_motion_ratio stays the render-side diagnostic

garment.cloth_alive.reason: His tee is MetaHuman's own default garment (assembled to his body, WPO 0). It is a closed-shell mesh, and Chaos cloth on a closed shell collapses (round 5: her overshirt shredded), so no sim this round. The armour complaint is addressed by WPO 0 and the assembled fit (armor_index, wpo_cm and neck_px stay hard lines). Proxy-sim cloth (single-layer sim section + FMCloth mesh-to-mesh) is round 6.
